data.name: Wright Way Construction
data.address: 702 E Pleasant Run Rd, Cedar Hill, TX 75104

reviews.text:
Ray and his son Zach removed the mold from our kitchen (all the way to the drywall) and remodeled our 1980s kitchen and made it look new and luxurious! They also did some work on a window drywall that had mold too!

Working with Ray and his team was great! If there was anything wrong or wasn't done right they would redo it and most of the time before we even asked!

The team that worked on the kitchen was great! Omar, German, Isidro, Richard, Luis, and Noah all went above and beyond. I had a a lot of last minute changes and they accommodated it very well! Also a big mention to Omar because he did an amazing job and worked to make sure everything was kept clean before (mats to protect flooring), during (plastic to cover my son's toys), and after (vacuumed, mopped, and cleaned all the areas they were in). My son really liked interacting with Omar, G, and Zach so that was a nice touch.

Overall the project took 3 and a half weeks which was very very fast compared to other people who got their kitchen done.

Lastly, Zach did a great job communicating when the they would come over, who would come over, what time and if they weren't going to come over that day. This helped us to set an expectation on when to be ready.

We love our kitchen and we thank God that we met Ray and that he did our project!
reviews.author: Andrew Car

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction helped us not only restore our kitchen after a burst pipe in the ceiling caused extensive damage, but also worked with us to add some remodeling to the scope. They raised the drop ceiling, designed and built custom upper cabinets to fit our unique space needs, updated and painted the lower cabinets, redid the backsplash, and installed all of our new appliances. Ray and Zach  helped us with ideas for how to best utilize the space and were very responsive throughout the process. Their work crews were respectful and honest. Our kitchen has been completely transformed and we're loving the new look and feel of the space!
reviews.author: Jessi Urban Havens

reviews.text: Wright Way converted our back porch into a sun-room / office / guest-room. Every single expectation was exceeded. I had an idea of what it would look like...the end result was far beyond what I imagined...better in every way. All the workers were courteous, respectful and friendly. Communication was very consistent. HIGHLY recommended!!!
reviews.author: Cameron Woodall

reviews.text: Ray Wright Construction did an excellent job upgrading our laundry room and replacing all of the windows and doors around our home. The categories we are using to rate the quality of work we received to give a 5 star rating are: providing ideas for upgrading, respect, communication, and coordinating installation are definitely top notch in every category! Ray Wright listens to what you want and makes the magic happen!
reviews.author: Dwight Roberson

reviews.text: This was our second home update that Wright Way has successfully completed for us in a little over 1 year. The most recent project was a total renovation of both a luxury vinyl plank floor and carpet. Ray helped us to choose a quality product for both by providing samples that were brought to our home. Such ease! Ray & Zach are honorable men to work with. We even left town for this project & trusted them with access to our home for them & their great crews to complete the project. They provided pictures & updates to communicate the progress. They were very responsive to any concern that we expressed. Highly recommend them for your next home remodel project.
reviews.author: Shari Warkentin

reviews.text: They were very organized. I was impressed with how they put down flooring protection and didn’t leave messes during the process. We did a whole room that included some paint and drywall repairs and custom cabinetry/bar area. We are happy with the results. They moved quickly and it was nice to have the project done and taken off our list. Ray brought samples by my house which saved me a lot of time and effort. I did go pick a slab for countertops in person. They were flexible and accommodating.
reviews.author: Ashley Odeh

reviews.text:
Updated: 11/29/2023 - I just had Wright Way Construction remodel my kitchen and living room. It was a big job but again, Ray and his team did a spectacular job. I am so happy with the work that they did. I have beautiful custom cabinets in my kitchen and a wonderful custom built book shelf in my living room. I highly recommend Wright Way Construction.

We have been using Wright Way Construction for almost 20 years for various renovations on our house. Ray and his team have always done top quality, professional work. I wouldn't think of using anyone else.Ray always works with me to make sure the finished product is exactly what I wanted.  His crews are professional, courteous, and knowledgable. I am so pleased with the work Wright Way Construction provides and I am always glad to recommend them to anyone needing home improvements.
reviews.author: Paulette Deutman

reviews.text:
For over 10 years I've sought a contractor capable of doing a major residential architectural redesign and repairs.  He listened, assessed and proposed several options.  We settled on one and they implemented on time, to budget and to specs.

His workers are craftsmen, diligent and respectful of our home.  We remained in our home while construction was performed around us.  They went the extra mile to accommodate our schedule and even moved some our belonging from room to room to keep the project on schedule.

They solved a major architectural problem and redesigned the space into a fabulously functional asset to the house.  This makes the house more livable, comfortable and entertaining.

Wright Way and Team are great. I highly recommend them and will use them again!

Below is one of many rooms that was transformed into a beautiful respite.
reviews.author: Stephen D. Marino

reviews.text:
Our house flooded during storms in Aug 2022, due to old gutters & other structural issues. This caused plenty of damage, including ruining the carpeted library, so we decided to take the opportunity to have it redone. We found Wright Way, liked their ideas & prices, and signed up. They installed new, extra large gutters in the backyard and we haven't had any flooding issues at all since (and no more panic attacks for me!) The library is a beauty now and my favorite room in the house. They took out the old wallpaper from the 80s & repainted the walls, then laid a waterproof wood vinyl laminate on the floors. You can see the difference in the before & after pics!

Everyone with the company, from the owners to the actual crew, were always professional and friendly. We have a large list of projects that we still want to do around the house, when we have money, and will definitely be going back to Wright Way!
reviews.author: Jenn I

reviews.text:
Wright Way Construction was impressive! They communicated well, letting me know each step, and why. The men at my home were professional, friendly, and considerate.
They worked hard and cleaned up so well, it was hard to see I had workmen here. The landscapers and tree removal crew,  the roofers, and the attic encapsulation crew were exceptional, doing that little extra to show they cared about details and doing a job well. They even laid down plastic in my house and tarps around my home to catch old shingles, insulation, trash and such. I would use them again in a heartbeat! Love the great results!!
reviews.author: Debbie Raikes

reviews.text: Our experience with Wright Way was very positive.  The quality of construction and the skill sets of the crews were very high.  We had a carport built with a drive extension, followed by a workshop.  Wright Way matched the architecture of the home so both structures compliment the home and appeal of the lot.  It was important to us to use a professional, locally owned business and we were pleased with the close communication maintained by the owner and his son, Ray and Zack.
reviews.author: Thomas Hollingsworth

reviews.text: Ray and his team were very easy to work with during the remodel of my parent's house for my son. They did a total gutting of the house. New kitchen and bathrooms, replaced and moved the HVAC, rewired the whole house. New siding on the exterior, as well as a driveway and fence. He can take your ideas and make them a reality.

reviews.text: I am a repeat customer and will continue to be. Thank you Wright Way Construction for overhauling my home exterior. The work your team did will preserve and protect our home for years to come. The steel front door your team installed made a BIG impact on our front entry-way.

reviews.text: Great company with very trustworthy people! We had a custom coffee bar built and it was one of the best investments we made in our home. They were efficient, respectful and did beautiful work!

reviews.text:

They took care of the roof in one day, and it looks amazing. I almost missed Zach and the fence crew, cuz they were so fast and professional. The fence looks great as well.
Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Ben Urban

reviews.text: Ray and his crew went above and beyond. To build my project. Was very clear in the quote and worked with me when I changed the design a little.  He went several times in my small city to the building inspector to get the clearances needed to permit and when that was done start to finish was about 4 weeks.  I really loved with their years of experience thought of things I would not have like drainage and outside electrical plugs.   The team was responsive to any concerns and handled them in a professional manner.  Overall a great experience and would certainly recommend wright way construction
reviews.author: lisa evans

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction is a wonderful and professional company.  Ray and Zach were such a pleasure to work with during our kitchen remodel.  They took our ideas and made them a reality.  Their attention to detail and quality of work is outstanding.  They are honest, reliable, and great communicators.  From day 1 to the finish they showed up everyday.  Their crews are professional and polite as well, and they never left anything a mess.  They cleaned up everyday!  They exceeded our expectations and turned our 25 year-old kitchen into a beautiful space.  We plan to use them again to remodel our master bath. They are truly the best!
reviews.author: Gwyn Reynolds

reviews.text: I highly recommend Wright Way Construction. They took care of our roof quickly and professionally, and the quality of their work is excellent. I have no complaints.
reviews.author: Courtney Raikes

reviews.text:
We recently had our kitchen, master bathroom and living area wall arrangement remodeled by Wright Way Construction, and we could not be happier.  The entire team was amazing and a pleasure to work with from the initial consultation through the final inspections.  The company owner and project manager Ray, along with general foreman Zach, kept us informed every step of the way and promptly addressed our questions or concerns.
The excellent craftsmanship and attention to detail in the finished space are truly impressive.
Along with the remodeling, we had walls, floors, stairs, and ceilings refurbished in other rooms giving us an entirely exciting and high-quality home interior.  We are grateful to Wright Way Construction for bringing our vision to life.
As a side note, during the project, a weather event left us with significant roof shingle damage. Ray worked alongside the insurance adjuster, and we were able to quickly contract Wright Way Construction to replace our roof prior to any weather damage to the interior ceilings of the home.
If all of this sounds to-good-to-be-true, ask Ray or Zach, they can show you the pictures!
reviews.author: Paul Madej

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction did a total home renovation that lasted about 6 weeks. I have had others do work on our home over the past 40 years and was often disappointed in the quality of their work. I am extremely pleased with the work that Wright Way Construction did.  Ray was very helpful in helping me choose the right floor, wall colors, granite countertops, etc. I put my trust in his expertise, and I was not disappointed.  His son, Zach, is the General Foreman. Zach and his crew were extremely hard workers. They always cleaned the site at the end of the day. Communication was excellent. Zach is one of the most kind, considerate, and trustworthy young men I have ever met. I highly recommend Wright Way Construction to anyone who is looking for someone to do any kind of work on their home!
reviews.author: Patty Milam

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction is the best! Our home suffered a leak that ruined our kitchen and flooring. In the process of finding a contractor who could help us fulfill our dream design, Ray and Zach came highly recommended and stood out above the rest. They were always responsive, dependable, and reliable. As we ran into hurdles with our insurance company, Ray was patient and helped walk us through the process. They finished at the initially promised completion date despite our multiple changes and adjustments during construction. If a design request had never been done before, they not only found a way to make it work but also look good. Their subcontractors were friendly, trustworthy and had a passion for their work that shows in the final product. We will be recommending Wright Way Construction to everyone, and if you weren’t sure, we will be using them again for further projects.

reviews.text: Working with Wright Way was great. Great communication and quality work. Our house looks amazing.

reviews.text: They replace the roof on our church. Were there and completed the job in a day and a half. Outstanding job and Ray followed up to make certain we were satisfied....highly recommend them.
reviews.author: David Richardson

reviews.text: We suffered a night of very substantial water damage on Christmas Eve of 2022 that caused us to need to replace the whole first level of flooring, entire kitchen, as well as many other areas. Some good local friends of ours pointed us to Wright Way because they thoroughly appreciated some work that was done for them as well. It was an absolute blessing to get that information. Ray and the other members of Wright Way helped us through literally every step of the claim and restoration process. They were immediately responsive to any questions and always very present throughout everything. Their care and professionalism sets an extremely high standard that I do not believe can be matched. It was clear that Wright Way construction wanted to treat us like family and fulfill every last one of our needs to the letter as well as going above and beyond what would typically be expected of a similar organization. We were provided with a clear cut estimation of costs with no surprises or changes and no fine print. The work was also completed in a fraction of the projected amount of time needed. Our neighbors even commented how hard everyone involved seemed to be working while we were moved out. There is no doubt in our minds that these are the only professionals that we will be trusting our home with in any future projects and the only ones that we will be  strongly recommending to any others in need of repair and restoration as well as additions and updates to your homes as well.
reviews.author: brady tedrow

reviews.text: We are so grateful that we went with Wright Way Construction. They were amazing! Both Ray, and Zach any other trades who came out to our house were professional and did everything with excellence. They communicated great with us and included us in the process. They were courteous and hard working. They did our floors, painted walls, new countertops, black splash and cabinets and even installed beautiful french doors (doors not insurance related) and all of it turned out amazing! reviews.text: I would give Wright Way Construction and Ray Wright a ten star review if possible. Without a doubt, this is the "right way" to go! Ray and his team of experts are the BEST contracting service in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. My husband and I hired this professional team to assist in the renovation of our house that was destroyed by renters. Ray worked with us on a flexible financial plan, and he accommodated our needs. Ray strives for customer satisfaction, and he was even available to protect our property at 10:30 pm when a water leak occurred. I wish our house was as nice years ago while my family lived there as it is now. It is a total transformation for the better! Ray and his professional team of experts exceeded our expectations. One of the team members summed it up the best when he commented, "The house has come back to life!" I am grateful for Ray and his team that made the "resurrection" happen. The house is selling itself. My husband and I listed the house at 3 pm yesterday and had multiple offers by midnight the same day. We cannot thank Ray and his team enough. In my opinion, you will not be disappointed hiring Wright Way Construction Enterprises, Inc. They are an answer to prayers and a blessing from God (James 1:17)!

reviews.text:
We were a little unsure of what we wanted to improve our outdoor living area. Ray Wright dutifully gave us an estimate on our initial thoughts, but he could sense our hesitancy. He started asking questions and helping us to see other possible ideas - less expensive ideas.

We latched onto a great and affordable idea and decided to move forward with a 12'x36' patio extension tied into the existing property. Our goals were to give us a great outdoor living space, drastically increase the shade in our western-facing back yard, make the extension look like it was always part of the house, add plenty of smart lighting and power, create a space for a hot tub, and satisfy the HOA.

In one week's time - much faster than we assumed - we had our new patio! With every goal met. And we love it. We spend even more time outside than we thought we would.

I can't say enough about Wright Way's integrity (guiding me to see a less expensive solution that in hindsight makes so much more sense than our original idea), speed, quality, and flexibility (when during construction I had some minor alterations).

I highly recommend Wright Way for any construction project for your home.

reviews.text: We used Wright Way Construction for a remodel of our master bath to accommodate my husband being in a wheelchair. It took less than three weeks from start to finish and all I can say is that it looks like a spa. The entire crew was professional, courteous and capable. Each day they cleaned up and we’re respectful of the fact that we had to live in the construction. Would I recommend them?  That is a resounding YES. As a matter of fact we are getting a quote to redo the guest bathroom and will do it all again. I wish I could post pictures.

reviews.text:
It’s wonderful to express how a brighter, more well laid-out space, can bring the sense of calm into your home.

My wife and I worked with WWCE to redo a 10x18 ft space that was a master bath and separate, small his & her closets. The project was driven by the need to re-do a leaking shower pan/drain that was known when we purchased our home. But we disliked the dark cave-like shower and felt the entire bathroom/closet space was poorly laid out as a narrow, U-shaped walkway with all light switches hidden behind one of the six doors. Add to that my wife disliked the colors of the re-fried bean counters and tub… This was going to be quite the project.

We met with Mr. Ray and discussed our dislikes for the bathroom and thoughts on repairing the shower and trying to add more closet space. Mr. Ray took our ideas and gave us an option to repair the shower and move the sink which created a larger bathroom and 1 larger closet. We liked the idea, and it was very cost-effective, but it didn’t completely remedy how we felt about the space and what it seemed to be lacking.

Back to the drawing board, we thought more conceptually about what we would do in this space if there weren’t any obstacles. That way of thinking led us to the answer: Redo it all!  We love the view across our back yard and the woods behind us and decided to add a second larger window for additional natural light. How nice it would look with a tub placed by it? Put the shower where the tub was and move the toilet to open the space up in the bathroom and then use the other half of the space for a much larger master closet.

Construction started with the complete gutting of the space. This was quickly followed by jackhammering the slab and moving all the drain locations. We upgraded the exterior walls to 2x6 studs for better insulation and sheeted the new closet with OSB and drywall so that it’s better reinforced and can double as more suitable tornado shelter. Texture, electrical, and the stonework seemed to happen simultaneously. Then flooring, trim and paint and we were about ready to move back in. The final touches were the WWCE signature vanity (a furniture like piece with optimized under sink storage and outlet), frameless shower glass, and the new windows, ordered to match the existing windows in our house. We had two items on our punch list that were quickly addressed, and we were moving back in after 6 weeks’ worth of work.

FULL DISCLOSURE: I’m related to the Wright’s, but if you’d assume this automatically discredits this review, please consider the following:

First the Wright Family honors Mark 12: 30 and 31 which states 30 Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’ 31 The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.” I know that the Wrights would like the opportunity to show you what it means to live this out through working with you.

Second: There is no obligation for me to disclose this but felt it’s the right thing to do with the hopes that hearing of our experience will allow you to gain better insight into who you are considering hiring.

Third: As a licensed Professional Engineer in the State of Texas and have spent my career in oil and gas facilities design and construction. This has helped me to know what a good contractor looks like.

reviews.text: WWCE served as the general contractor on a major re-roofing project for our church. The project involved both shingled roofing and flat roofing. Prior to the work WWCE completed we had major roof leak issues throughout the building. Since the completion of the roof replacement work, that included re-decking, putting on all new shingles and installation of a completely new TPO system on the flat roof areas, we have not had a single leak. This building is over 50 years old and now has a far better roof than the original. Working with WWCE and Ray Wright was a great experience. Highly professional, excellent service, and extremely responsive. We would use them again and highly recommend their services.
reviews.author: David Carr

reviews.text: They did a great job repairing my front porch, painting the exterior of my house and installing the gutters. They were professional and true craftsmen. I will definitely call on them again when I have another remodeling project.
reviews.author: Troy P

reviews.text: Mr. Wright and his team are phenomenal. After dealing with poor contractors in the past, I have found a company where I am at ease. The team was on time, professional, and a joy to work with. Do yourself a favor and conduct all home repairs with Mr. Wright.
reviews.author: Belinda Tyner

reviews.text: I’ve used Wright Way for several projects in my home. Ray, Zach and the entire crew were very professional and do quality work. Great attention to detail and very affordable. Would highly recommend them and will use them again in  the future.
reviews.author: Ash Nelms

reviews.text: This is the fourth project on which we’ve worked with Ray and his crew. He has solved a recurring garage water problem, remodeled our guest house and rebuilt our utility shed and barn. We appreciate his excellent diagnostic skills and the professional (and courteous) standards he and his family uphold. We look forward to collaborating with them again on future projects.
reviews.author: John Granatino

reviews.text: Excellent company that provides excellent and friendly customer service. Their workmanship and attention to detail is superb. We had their company remove and replace flooring in a significant area of our home. It turned out beautifully. They also painted several bedrooms and replaced an exterior door. They use high quality products and are committed to keeping their pricing competitive. Ray and his team are very knowledgeable and I don’t think there is a job that they wouldn’t be able to do! We highly recommend this company. You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: Susan Hord

reviews.text: Very professional & did an amazing job of re-shingling our house.  His cleaned up their mess & few cut a few tree limbs that we couldn't get to while they were up on the roof.  I will call them for future repairs & upgrades.  Very friendly & easy to deal with - thank goodness my only headache was the insurance adjuster.
reviews.author: Lisa Richardson

reviews.text: Used them to replace a bay window and put in a new fence. We love the job they did on both. Very competitive with their pricing, especially on the bay windows. The work was done quickly and cleanly. Will definitely look to use them again for future home remodel and repair work.
reviews.author: Austin DePue

reviews.text: I have worked with Wright Way Construction for several home projects and can’t say enough good things about them! I was dreading getting new flooring because of all of the moving beforehand and the mess afterwards. They came in and moved everything for me, replaced everything where it should go, and left the house clean and tidy! I highly recommended them for any construction projects.
reviews.author: Kimmerie Ellis

reviews.text: This was the best experience I’ve ever had with a remodel. They were professional, the communication was amazing, they answered my questions and corners before I even had chance to ask, and the attention to detail was top tier. I could go on and on because I can’t say enough good things, and will hands down be using them for my other upcoming projects.
reviews.author: Seth Williams

reviews.text: Top notch contractor!   I don't trust anyone else to work on my home.  From the owner to the sub-contractors everyone does quality work and are so professional.   They show up when they are supposed to and work hard all day.   If you want the best - hire the best - Wright Way Construction.
reviews.author: Lily D. Cow

reviews.text: They did a fantastic job removing and installing new floors throughout our whole house.  We were kept informed throughout the project and they answered all our questions we had.  They were great to work with! We will be using them again to do some renovations around our house soon! I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Ashley Bridges

reviews.text: We found Wright Way construction by referral, but the first thing they did for us was repair a leak from the winter storm, which was under the tile in the laundry room.  A pipe had broken in the concrete and was flooding our kitchen. They had come to our house to give us a quote on some other work, but squeezed us into their schedule to get this leak repaired in record time. Now you would never know there had been an issue. Everyone was very professional all the way through the process including dealing with insurance company.
reviews.author: TAnn C.

reviews.text: Ray worked with us on a master bath remodel. He showed great attention to detail and his suggestions were extremely helpful. Zach was indispensable as the daily "go to guy" and along with Hector was a pleasure to work with. The project was done on time and on budget and looks great!
reviews.author: Ann Wentz

reviews.text: WWCE re-roofed and replaced all the siding on our home. In addition they added a large double gate to our fence and completed concrete work. They were competitive on price, prompt on getting to work, kept things on schedule and highly professional. Having a "one-stop" option to take care of all our needs made things so simple. We would use them again and highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Dave Carr

reviews.text: Ray and Zach are stellar. Their team finished a project that, for us, was just in the dream stage. They added their design capabilities and we ended up with much more than we could ever imagine. And on top of that...all within budget. They are AWESOME!
reviews.author: kyle orrell

reviews.text: Wright Way had completed a job for another company, when I saw the work I contacted them to see what they could on a project I had. They came out immediatly got the details and quoted quickly. They scheduled the job, showed up when they said and completed it when they said with no issues. Easy to work with and made sure the job was done right the first time.
reviews.author: Craig Smethie

reviews.text: New shower install. Workers were always polite and cleaned up after themselves each day. The job took longer than expected but in the end the job was well done and we are satisfied with our new shower.
reviews.author: Connie Walters

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Wright Way Construction! Ray and Zach were very professional and communicative. We will be using them again for sure!
reviews.author: Liz Rivera

reviews.text: My project included removal of dead tree removal (very large red oak), install new roof (including flat roof, tin roof, and shingles),  repair water damage inside garage (drywall and paint), outdoor prep and paint (3 colors, entire house),  install attic crawl space access ladder,  apply open cell foam insulation in attic crawl space (including vacuum removal of existing attic insulation).  Great attention to detail and high quality workmanship.  Any defects were IMMEDIATELY corrected.  I received timely communication via text and phone call during the entire project.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text: All excellent work. Craftsmanship of all trades was outstanding, especially cabinetry. They took special care to protect all existing, adjacent surfaces. All of the people were very nice and pleasant to deal with thru the entire project.
reviews.author: Weldon Nash

reviews.text: Wonderful, professional family owned business. Honest & reliable, good communication & make things right if expectations not achieved. Project target date was met & with good attention to every detail. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Doc Warkentin

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction is the best of the best.  They are Honest and they do the job right.  They remodeled our master bathroom and laid new flooring.  What an amazing difference.
reviews.author: daniel Walton

reviews.text: I've used the folks at Wright Way for almost all my building or repair projects at my home. They've really proven themselves to be trustworthy and reliable, and so far every project has turned out better than I had hoped. Thankful for businesses like this one in my area.
reviews.author: Jimmy Needham

reviews.text: Fantastic work.  Mind full of time. Excellent suggestions for lay out, design and material    Always had a feel for what we needed and listened to our wants.  Very trustworthy and polite. All the personnel that worked on the remodel were knowledgeable in their craft and presented themselves in a professional manor.
reviews.author: Perin Warren

reviews.text: We loved working with this company. They are friendly, they care about quality, aesthetics, listening to the customer, and making helpful suggestions, but are not at all pushy. We are very pleased with the remodeling in our home, have referred others to them, and will use them in the future.
reviews.author: Kenneth Embry

reviews.text:
Complete remodel of master bath and Jack-and-Jill bath ceiling to floor. Amazing work words cannot adequately describe. They also remodeled the entire exterior of our house two years ago.

We got bids and ideas from several contractors but NONE came close to their bid for what they were going to do.
reviews.author: Mark EMc

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction was hired to add a rework a shop into a third bedroom, add a closet, and add a shower to an existing bath.  They did an outstanding job.
reviews.author: Dean Philpott

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction is always my first choice. Everyone is kind and courteous, and our projects go smoothly.
reviews.author: Jan Lewis

reviews.text: I found them to be professional, honest, courteous and it was easy to do business with them. Their prices are competitive and fair. I am very pleased with the new fence; Enough so that I just emailed a picture to brag about it to my family!
reviews.author: James Walton

reviews.text: We found him via a recommendation from a friend and look forward to working with him again. We had a new roof put on and he helped us every step of the way. Work was quality, they cleaned up after themselves after the work was done and we felt listened to throughout the whole process.
reviews.author: Erin Bray

reviews.text: We have used WWCE on several projects over the years and have always been completely satisfied with the results. WWCE does quality work using quality materials and will always be our preferred choice.
reviews.author: Robert Erwin

reviews.text: I recently had some siding put on my house.  The workers arrived on time and worked on it until it was done.  They were very professional and knowledgeable.  I would recommend this company to others.
reviews.author: David Marshall

reviews.text: They remodeled our kitchen and installed new lighting. We are very pleased with the service and response time. We will be using them again for future renovations.
reviews.author: CC Stuart

reviews.text:
Very prompt and great work.  Nice and polite.
Always checking on job to make sure it is done right.
reviews.author: Sheila Cox

reviews.text: Professional, timely, tidy and responsive...Zach was a pleasure to work with and communicated daily on all accounts.  He met my expectations!
reviews.author: Claudia Gorman

reviews.text: This is the second time I've use WWCE. They again performed on time, on budget, and did excellent work. Would highly recommend them for about any project.
reviews.author: Jon Galbraith

reviews.text: Wright Way Construction handled my attic repairs with the utmost professionalism. I would recommend their services to anyone.
reviews.author: Cathy Pennycuff

reviews.text: The removal of a gigantic tree in one day including clean up was amazing.  What a team of workers!  My neighbors noticed the details.
reviews.author: Paula Wissler

reviews.text:
Would recommend Wright Way for any remodeling project…. Great work and good quality !!
Zach was amazing!!!!!
reviews.author: Deborah Jordan

reviews.text: The best customer service and the sweetest family ever! Anything you need, call them!!  Great attention to detail with their work and very honest.
reviews.author: byron knight

reviews.text: Amazing company and fantastic job! Incredible attention to detail and incredibly considerate.
reviews.author: Nelson H. Huff III
